sections.title: SRN PLAINS TODAY INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: THE CLOSED MID LEVEL LOW CENTERED OVER NRN NM THIS MORNING WILL MOVE SLOWLY NEWD TOWARD W/SW KS BY 12Z SAT AS EMBEDDED SPEED MAXIMA ROTATE AROUND THE SRN AND ERN PERIPHERY OF THE LOW. AT THE SURFACE...A CYCLONE WILL PERSIST TODAY NEAR THE NE NM/SE CO BORDER...BEFORE DRIFTING INTO SW KS OVERNIGHT AND WEAKENING. FARTHER S...THE PATTERN WILL BE MUDDLED BY THE IMPACTS OF PRIOR AND ONGOING CONVECTION ACROSS TX...THOUGH A REMNANT DRYLINE/PACIFIC COLD FRONT WILL MOVE SLOWLY EWD ACROSS W TX AND THE TX PANHANDLE THROUGH THE DAY. AN EXTENSIVE NNE-SSW ORIENTED BAND OF THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS CENTRAL TX THIS MORNING WILL LIKELY PERSIST THROUGH THE DAY AND DEVELOP EWD TOWARD E TX...SUPPORTED BY THE MODERATE ELEVATED CAPE NOTED IN THE 12Z SOUNDINGS AS FAR E AS LCH-SHV. ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED ALONG THE SE FLANK OF THIS ONGOING ACTIVITY...WHERE CONVECTION WILL HAVE ACCESS TO THE RICHEST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE/INSTABILITY FEED ACROSS S CENTRAL TX AND THE MIDDLE TX COASTAL PLAIN /PER THE 2500-3000 J/KG MLCAPE AT CRP AND BRO/. THIS CONVECTION WILL BE ROOTED AT OR VERY NEAR THE GROUND...AND VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR EMBEDDED BOWS/SUPERCELLS. EFFECTIVE SRH OF 200-300 M2/S2

sections.title: EAST TEXAS
sections.text: THE LATEST WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS AN UPPER-LEVEL LOW OVER THE SRN ROCKIES WITH A BROAD DRY SLOT EXTENDING EWD TO AN MCS LOCATED IN ECNTRL TX. THE MCS WILL MOVE ENEWD ACROSS EAST TX THIS AFTERNOON. THE SRN PART OF THE MCS SHOULD STRENGTHEN MOVING EWD ALONG A WARM FRONT AND GRADIENT OF MODERATE INSTABILITY INTO THE HOUSTON/GALVESTON AREAS. ALTHOUGH MUCH OF THE MCS MAY BE SLIGHTLY ELEVATED ATTM...FORECAST SOUNDINGS QUICKLY WEAKEN THE CAP OVER SE TX OVER THE 1-2 HOURS WHICH WILL ALLOW THE STORMS TO BECOME SFC-BASED. STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES ALREADY IN PLACE WILL SUPPORT ISOLATED SUPERCELLS. IN ADDITION...THE RUC ANALYZES A 45 TO 55 KT LOW-LEVEL JET OVER SOUTHEAST TEXAS AND THE HOUSTON WSR-88D VWP CONFIRMS THIS WITH A 55 KT SLY WIND AT 1 KM. THIS IS PRODUCING A LOW-LEVEL SHEAR ENVIRONMENT FAVORABLE FOR AT LEAST AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT. THIS THREAT SHOULD EXPAND EWD WITH TIME AND MAY AFFECT AREAS OF FAR SE TX LATER THIS AFTERNOON. NORTH OF THE WARM FRONT IN THE LUFKIN AND TYLER AREAS...INSTABILITY DROPS OFF DRAMATICALLY AND VERTICAL SHEAR IS WEAKER. THESE TWO FACTORS SHOULD KEEP THE SEVERE THREAT MORE ISOLATED AS THE SQUALL-LINE OVER ECNTRL TX AFFECTS NERN TX THIS AFTERNOON.

sections.title: WCNTRL TX/TX PANHANDLE/WRN OK/SE CO/SW KS
sections.text: A 65 TO 75 KT MID-LEVEL JET IS CURRENTLY ROUNDING THE BASE OF AN WELL-DEVELOPED UPPER-LEVEL LOW OVER THE SRN ROCKIES. AT THE SFC...A WELL-DEFINED DRYLINE IS PRESENT EXTENDING SEWD ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE INTO WCNTRL TX. THUNDERSTORMS WITH HAIL POTENTIAL ARE ONGOING ON THE NERN SIDE OF THE UPPER-LEVEL LOW OVER SE CO AND THE OK PANHANDLE. MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE STEEP AND TEMPS ALOFT ARE COLD ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPPER-LEVEL LOW. THIS SHOULD CONTINUE TO BE FAVORABLE FOR HAIL ESPECIALLY AS SFC TEMPS WARM THIS AFTERNOON. THE HAIL THREAT SHOULD EXPAND SEWD WITH TIME ACROSS THE ERN TX PANHANDLE WHICH IS SUPPORTED BY THE SHORT-RANGE MODELS. FURTHER SOUTH ALONG THE DRYLINE IN WCNTRL TX...SFC DEWPOINTS ARE CURRENTLY IN THE UPPER 50S F. THE AIRMASS IS NOT YET UNSTABLE DUE TO LOW CLOUD COVER IN THE WAKE OF AN MCS WHICH WILL CONTINUE TO HAMPER DESTABILIZATION THIS AFTERNOON...DELAYING CONVECTIVE INITIATION UNTIL THIS EVENING ALONG THE DRYLINE. BY THAT TIME...03Z MODEL FORECASTS DEVELOP SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY IN A STRONGLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT FOR SUPERCELLS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS THIS EVENING ACROSS WCNTRL TX SHOW 55 TO 65 KT OF VERTICAL SHEAR WITH 500 MB TEMPS IN THE -17 TO -19 C RANGE. THIS SHO

sections.title: NWRN TX INTO PART OF CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: EXPANDED THE NWRN EXTENT OF SEVERE PROBABILITIES AND ACCOMPANYING SLGT RISK INTO A BIT MORE OF SERN CO/SWRN KS BASED ON CLEARING SKIES AND EXPECTATION OF NNWWD MOVING SHALLOW MOIST CONVECTION THROUGH THE EVENING. LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL BE PRIMARY THREATS AS HEATING WITHIN WRN FRINGE OF LOW CLOUD DECK NEAR DRY LINE SUPPORTS CONVECTIVE INITIATION FROM PARTS OF NWRN TX INTO SERN CO BETWEEN 21-00Z. ZONE OF SEVERE WILL REMAIN QUITE NARROW AS CLOUDS AND WEAKENING INSTABILITY WILL PERSIST OVER MUCH OF OK/KS/N-CENTRAL TX.

sections.title: REST OF TX
sections.text: MESSY CONVECTIVE FORECAST WILL PERSIST ALONG AND JUST NORTH OF COASTAL FRONT OVER SERN TX INTO THE TX COASTAL BEND THROUGH THE EVENING. 45-55 KT SLY LLJ AROUND 1 KM CONTINUES TO BE SAMPLED ON VWPS ALONG THE COAST...WHICH WILL MAINTAIN AT LEAST A RISK OF AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO WITH THE STRONGER CORES NEAR THE SURFACE FRONT. TORNADO THREAT WITH DISCRETE DEVELOPMENT WITHIN WARM SECTOR NEAR THE COASTAL BEND WILL ALSO BEAR CLOSE MONITORING THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING. OTHERWISE...LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS ARE EXPECTED. APPEARS SUFFICIENT SLY LOW LEVEL WAA AND MODEST MUCAPE WILL MAINTAIN POTENTIAL FOR ELEVATED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IN WAKE OF LARGE MCS NOW MOVING ACROSS ERN TX. EVENTUAL EVOLUTION INTO ANOTHER LARGE CONVECTIVE CLUSTER WITH ACCOMPANYING ISOLATED SEVERE SHOULD EVOLVE LATE TONIGHT OVER CENTRAL/SRN TX. ..EVANS.. 04/17/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1128 AM CDT FRI APR 17 2009/
